fact_dispositions.subject: main/melee/gm/gmcameramode:gm_Mode_Camera_OnInit
fact_dispositions.value: Passes the address of gmMainLib_804D3EE0->modes.vs_camera to gm_InitVsMode for in-place initialization. That persistent VsModeData is subsequently copied into Camera Mode's character-select, stage-select, and battle scene data, while changed selections and match results are written back to it.
fact_dispositions.reason: Initialization call is verified, but complete claim extends to unread CSS/SSS callbacks or external gameplay descriptions.

canonical_evidence.why: Complete function definition establishes local calls and writes.
